[WTF] Minor clarifications to MemoryOrder comments in Atomics.h
https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=329268
rdar://191218633

Reviewed by Keith Miller.

Note which half of an AcquireRelease read-modify-write is the Acquire and which is the Release,
that the RCpc note covers read-modify-writes, and which parts of each operation SeqCst's ordering
applies to.

* Source/WTF/wtf/Atomics.h:
(WTF::Atomic<T>::loadAndFence const): Note that despite its name this isn't a fence.
